# mooncake cron remove

Remove a mooncake-managed cron.d entry

## Description

Deletes /etc/cron.d/<name> if it is managed by mooncake os.cron.
Use --force to remove files not managed by mooncake.

Exit codes:
  0  removed (or already absent)
  1  file not found
  2  error (unreadable, not managed without --force, etc.)

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--dir` | string | `/etc/cron.d` | Path to cron.d directory |
| `--force / -f` | bool | false | Remove even if not managed by mooncake |
